name: A clip that answers somebody opens on them
description: The viewer message the clip answers, drawn the way the chat showed it, held for the first seconds; the hook comes in as it goes.
when: the clip was cut from a stream recording and answers something a viewer said in the chat

then.prompt: If the clip answers a message from the chat, the video opens on that message and the hook comes in after it. If nobody asked, do not invent one: the clip opens on the hook instead.
